text: Bosch Ltd. (BOSCHLTD) shares trade around ₹41,200 to ₹41,525 on Indian stock exchanges, supported by strong annual results for fiscal year 2026.

sections.title: Key Financial Performance Metrics
bullet_points: Balance Sheet: Virtually debt-free with strong operating margins (~14%) 🌐 Perplexity ↗

sections.title: Recent News & Strategic Updates
bullet_points: Strong Annual Performance: Net profit growth was amplified by solid automotive sector demand (especially in powertrain and two-wheeler segments) and gains from selling the Building Technologies business. 🌐 Screener ↗
Major Acquisition: The board approved acquiring a 100% stake in Bosch Chassis Systems India for ₹9,068.68 crore to expand its ABS, sensor, and vehicle safety portfolio.
